hypothesis: Marginalizing trifecta predictions over plausible current-course assignments and ST uncertainty will improve distributional calibration, especially in non-identity course races, beyond a direct residual model.

scenario_generation.course: normalize the product of six runner course probabilities over all 720 course permutations
scenario_generation.st: predicted mean plus fixed residual quadrature offsets

outcome.form: v312-anchored three-stage lane utility residual conditioned on scenario course and ST
outcome.scenario_marginalization: weighted arithmetic mixture of 36 conditional trifecta distributions
